title: Drain a three-ticket local board
notes: The runner creates these three inline mini tickets on an isolated local-board project, then measures whether the worker drains them in dependency order.

miniTickets.title: Add a greeting module
miniTickets.body: Create src/greeting.js exporting greet(name), returning `Hello, <name>!`. Add a node:test covering Ada.

miniTickets.title: Add a greeting CLI
miniTickets.body: After the greeting module exists, create cli.js that prints greet(process.argv[2] || 'world'). Keep the module API unchanged.

miniTickets.title: Document and verify usage
miniTickets.body: Add README.md with the exact command `node cli.js Basenji` and its expected output. Run the complete test suite before finishing.
